pages.text: Covers in Refined Storage 2 are decorative blocks that conceal cables while still allowing connections to pass through with improved efficiency. They can be crafted using almost any solid block, allowing you to match your cable covers to your building's aesthetic with enhanced visual integration. Covers are essential for creating clean, visually appealing storage networks that blend seamlessly with your architectural style. RS2 features better block compatibility and improved connection reliability.

To place a Cover, right-click it onto a cable. The cover will take on the appearance of the block used to craft it with enhanced visual fidelity. To remove a Cover, use a Wrench on it. This versatility allows you to run complex cable networks through visible areas without compromising your build's appearance. RS2's Covers feature improved signal handling and better mod compatibility. Covers do not affect the functionality of the cables they conceal, now with enhanced network performance.
Cover Crafting Recipe. Almost any solid block can be used in the recipe.
